search_catalog.description: Match every case-folded query token against source title and keywords; return only matching IDs and bibliographic metadata, not source body. Empty or unmatched queries cannot authorize reading.
search_catalog.result: matches with source_id/title/url, query tokens and source_pack_sha256
search_catalog.side_effect: record allowed source IDs in task state

read_source.description: Read one source card only after its ID appeared in this run's search result; return full card plus canonical content hash. Duplicate or unknown IDs fail closed.

write_brief.description: Write only final-brief.md after all required sources were read. Content must equal the deterministic template populated from those source cards; this is not LLM generation.

parameters.content: fixed template built from successfully read cards

write_brief.result: path, UTF-8 byte count, written SHA-256, ordered source IDs
write_brief.side_effect: create exactly one brief in the current run directory
